people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Kish
people.line: Father of Saul, the first king of Israel

people.name: Matri
people.line: Saul's ancestral clan from the tribe of Benjamin.

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: He brought the tribe of Benjamin near by their families; and the family of the Matrites was chosen. Then Saul the son of Kish was chosen; but when they looked for him, he could not be found.
translations.bsb: Then he had the tribe of Benjamin come forward by its clans, and the clan of Matri was selected. Finally, Saul son of Kish was selected. But when they looked for him, they could not find him.
translations.kjv: When he had caused the tribe of Benjamin to come near by their families, the family of Matri was taken, and Saul the son of Kish was taken: and when they sought him, he could not be found.
translations.asv: And he brought the tribe of Benjamin near by their families; and the family of the Matrites was taken; and Saul the son of Kish was taken: but when they sought him, he could not be found.
